title: Brouillette House, 509 North First Street, Vincennes, Knox County, IN
notes: Significance: Sole surviving example of late 18th - early 19th century French construction in Indiana. // c. 1800.  Wood frame with clapboards.  Rectangular, one-and-a-half stories, 29'3" x 39'3".  Gable roof, wall construction made of vertical posts spaces from 8" - 20" apart, stone foundation.  Original porches (east and west sides) removed during 19th century, one stone chimney removed during 19th century.
